modern_mapping.palette: Modern true-color RGB PATINVERT equivalent; not a claim of reproducing Win3.1 16-color palette-index complements
modern_mapping.pattern: Same alternating55/AA cells, integer device-cell rounding independently on both axes, anchored at original physical top-left

modern_mapping.compositor: Owned per-drag layered overlay; hide/flush before sampling to exclude previous preview; no shared painting lock or global drag setting
modern_mapping.dpi: Per-monitor-aware coordinates are physical; unaware single-primary-display coordinates use absolute native SetWindowPos quantization. Unaware multiple-monitor and system-aware physical/logical DPI mismatch use native fallback.
modern_mapping.native_quantization_evidence: At physical144/logical96: logical SetWindowPos(43,75) gives physical(65,113). Scoped PMv2 SetWindowPos(64,112) still delivers app logical(43,75), then physical(65,113). Preview must match the native reachable position rather than bypass application positioning.
